source.description: product_id or feature_id that included this clause

sale_date.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to current time

product_id.description: Now optional - features can be independent

email.description: Email for external users (required with X-Redline-Token)

last_known_version.description: Optional: client's last known document version

name.description: Name for external users (required with X-Redline-Token)

role.description: editor, viewer, or external (defaults based on org role or share access)

rotate_token.description: If true, generate new token (invalidates old links)

history.description: optional full history (append handled client-side for MVP)

version.description: required for optimistic concurrency when updating redlines/history
